name: Seat lesson 1: the driver
description: A step-by-step lesson in the driver's seat of the Osa 21, with the lesson's guide (data/tutorials/school_driver.json) on the screen: the seat, the panels and what each control does, then your part of the drill from cold, one switch at a time, each highlighted, the next only once it is done. The rest of the crew are NPCs and the commander's orders come at your pace. A practice drone comes in when the lesson is ready for it. Fictional.
notes: Fictional. The Kesmark range (as kesmark_range_test.json), the vehicle cold at a halt. No crew_commander: the lesson gives the commander's orders (simcore/tutorial.hpp on_start). Crew class 1 so the demonstration around the learner is clean. The drone's numbers are PLACEHOLDERS; it is held on cue. when_targets_gone off: the lesson ends the mission, not the drone.

targets.name: Practice drone (placeholder)
targets.notes: Placeholder numbers. Held until the lesson brings it in (on_cue): about 29 km out from the north-west, slow and steady, so a first-time crew has time for every step.
